newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine energy firm sell-off attracts 14 firms.
newsitem.headline: Argentine energy firm sell-off attracts 14 firms.

text.p: Fourteen Argentine and foreign firms have bought tender forms to bid on the privatization of provincial utility Empresa Social de Energia de Buenos Aires (Eseba), state news agency Telam reported Wednesday.
Eseba vice-president Juan Mario Pedersoli was quoted by Telam as saying "we are very satisfied" with the number of firms prepared to pay the $35,000 cost of the tender forms and information.
The province of Buenos Aires expects to reap $1 billion from the sale.
Among those companies that came forth were five Chilean firms: Sociedad Austral de Electricidad, Chilquinta SA, Energis SA, Emel and Compania General de Electricidad.
Iberdrola from Spain also came forward.
Eseba serves about 1.3 million clients and generates annual sales of $700 million, Telam said.
Bids for generation and distribution facilities must be in by March 31, and preclassified bids containing financial details will be opened April 21.
Those interested in transportation facilities must present bids by June 30. Those envelopes will be opened July 18.
